description:
**Rescoped 2026-05-11 after code-state audit.**

Original framing (implement `VerifyReport` emit + optional OSCAL Assessment Results compat) is moot for the report-shape question (see `.5`). The existing `ValidatedPath` and `Error` types have basic `Display`/`Debug`, but the new error variants added by `.11`/`.12` (hostname binding failures, mailbox binding failures, etc.) need `Display` impls too.

What remains:

- **`Display` impls** on any new error variants added by `.11`/`.12`/`.13`. Human-readable single-line summaries: "hostname `evil.com` does not match SAN entries", "mailbox `alice@example.com` not in SAN rfc822Name set", etc.

- **`Debug` impls** with full structured output for new error variants.

- **If `.5` chose option B or C (structured findings):** ship `VerifyReport` emit. Display impl for human-readable summary. Optional JSON serializer behind a `serde-json` feature. Possible OSCAL Assessment Results JSON emit behind feature-gated `oscal-emit` cargo feature (connects to PKIX-ncab — OSCAL is one supported emit format, not canonical).

- **If `.5` chose option A (pass-through Result):** no structured-report work; just the Display/Debug impls above.

**Blocks on:** `.5` (decides whether structured-findings emit happens).
title: Display/Debug impls for new error variants + optional findings emit
